Method of Attack: Stored XSS injection vulnerability allowing attackers to inject JavaScript into pages
Modification of yuzo_related_post_options value in wp_options table to inject malicious script
Missing authentication checks due to improper use of is_admin function
Injected JavaScript causes redirection of visitors to scam and unwanted software sites
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Yuzo Related Posts plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of stored XSS vulnerability in WordPress plugin
Modification of plugin options via POST requests to administrative interface pages (/wp-admin/options-general.php and /wp-admin/admin-post.php)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious script host resolving to IP 176.123.9.53
Redirects to scam pages including tech support scams, surveys, unwanted extension pages
